trigger: an operator reads the rollout text and plans or monitors a staged rollout against a pre-v2 server
summary: Published retry timing said the need_full backoff climbs toward about 24 h; sync_scheduler.cpp caps it at 600 s plus up to 300 s jitter (a retry roughly every 10-15 minutes). Fixed in gate-fix governance r1 (9592e7a3b); symptom (warn log + dropped counter) added.
classification_rationale: A doc claim contradicts the enforcing scheduler constants.

trigger: a reader of the disk_actions README/definition on an upgraded agent
summary: README and definition said disk_actions is not consumed by the daily sync; the device_ci source now runs volumes/partitions/topology daily. Amended; plugin-docs JSON regenerated by the tool (9592e7a3b). Derived band HIGH (I4/E3); the reporter labelled it MEDIUM (native vs derived disagree; the derived band governs). Fixed and re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.
classification_rationale: Doc contradicted the new wiring in agent.cpp.

trigger: a reader of the hardware README/definition
summary: README said seven of twelve actions feed the record and chassis/baseboard/swap/machine_id do not; all four now do (eleven of twelve). Fixed with the definition text and regenerated JSON (9592e7a3b). Derived band HIGH (I4/E3); the reporter labelled it MEDIUM (native vs derived disagree; the derived band governs). Fixed and re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: a Linux host with CPU frequency scaling
summary: Linux cpu rows carry the live clock_mhz column, so the daily hash can change and force a full upload. Rejected for this change: the shared pinned digest includes the clock value, and the server registry is not touched here. Recorded as a follow-up.
classification_rationale: Behavioural note, not a doc contradiction; pin-constrained.

trigger: a reader of the ADR sender contract paragraph
summary: Stale sentence 'No agent v2 writer exists in this change' and a trim order without swap; corrected to point at the 2026-11-01 entry (9592e7a3b).
classification_rationale: Stale prose made false by this change.

trigger: a mutation that trims from the head, or a refused row-bearing section that leaks rows
summary: Added first-N survivor assertions after trim/cap (mutation-probed: head erase fails) and a row-bearing PERMISSION_DENIED case; removed commas from two Catch2 names (9592e7a3b).
classification_rationale: Missing test coverage, bounded blast radius.

trigger: a plugin call that blocks forever on the sync thread
summary: Seven more in-process dispatches run with no deadline; a hung plugin stalls the sync thread and its shutdown join. Accepted ruling (same policy as the 15 existing actions); a bounded wait for sync sources is a would-be follow-up.
classification_rationale: Accepted plan ruling; not a doc contradiction.
